No. Dishwasher detergent and the long wet cycle strip the seasoning and cause rust, often within a single wash. The pan isn't ruined, since you can scrub off the rust and re-season it, but it's avoidable damage.

Instead, wash by hand with hot water and a brush or scraper (a little soap is fine), dry immediately, and wipe on a thin layer of oil. Heating it briefly on the stove helps it dry fully.
